card.name: Small words inside breast and prostate cancer grading
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or spaces just before a tumor grade, receptor status or tissue-type term in breast or prostate cancer text, e.g. 'with', 'and', the gap before a Gleason score number.

modes.label: Breast condition and receptor lists
modes.description: A linking word or comma inside lists of breast tissue types or receptor markers such as HER2 and PR.

modes.description: The space right before the number in a Gleason score of 8 to 10 in prostate cancer trial text.
